definitions.definition: “valuation date” means the earliest of the following dates: 1. The date the spouses separate and there is no reasonable prospect that they will resume cohabitation. 2. The date a divorce is granted. 3. The date the marriage is declared a nullity. 4. The date one of the spouses commences an application based on subsection 5 (3) (improvident depletion) that is subsequently granted. 5. The date before the date on which one of the spouses dies leaving the other spouse surviving.

definitions.citation: Rules of Civil Procedure, R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 194
definitions.definition: "will" includes any testamentary instrument of which probate or administration may be granted.
